About Reminders

Reminders gathers every reminder in one timeline: events and tasks from Calendar and To-do, and reminders you add yourself. A reminder pops up while a page is open, and you can snooze it for 5 minutes, an hour or until tomorrow morning, or dismiss it. Reminders only show while a tab is open, because nothing runs in the background. Nothing is uploaded.
